assumptions: BindingGraph constructs parent, committed-generation and candidate edges from a finite typed snapshot, distinguishes bound root services from unresolved injections, and proves construction exactness. Its predicate AST is extracted from source and checked by Lean; the complete production graph builder is separately executed. Lock/snapshot acquisition remains a runtime contract.
The abstract pending list is the reverse of Rust's Vec stack; each adjacency list is represented in the corresponding pop order. Reversal preserves edge and root membership.
Rust HashSet membership/insertion corresponds to selected-list membership guarded by fresh insertion. dependents.remove corresponds to takeNeighbors on the finite map representation.
The proof has no fixed vertex, edge, path-length or root-count bound. Cycles, duplicate roots, self edges and absent catalog names are included.
The returned-instance theorem describes set membership after catalog filtering. Rust sort_unstable determines the concrete output order and HashMap/Arc semantics remain outside Lean.

evidence_commands.purpose: Runs the existing deployment model and the independent 512 three-node graph/seed regression cases; these finite cases supplement the arbitrary-size Lean proof.
Exercises selected-instance checkpoint, detach and shutdown freeze through the real process manager.

assumptions: Finite source snapshots supply key, minor, resolved realm, namespace, nearest configured parent and bound generation identity. The source probe executes real Any downcasts over constructed immutable lookup APIs.
A bound service with no generation contributes no instance edge and prevents candidate fallback. The model represents this separately from an unresolved binding.

The restricted source predicate parser accepts three bound comparison atoms with parentheses, && and ||; unsupported syntax fails closed. Lean checks the parsed AST equals candidateProgram and proves its specification for arbitrary parameters. Extraction/parser implementation, u32-to-Nat projection, rustc and standard collections are trusted.

The complete select_instances body is compiled byte-for-byte over stable catalog/context support APIs. Its 32,768 cases are regression evidence for snapshot construction; the unbounded graph construction/traversal proof is over the declared Snapshot representation.
Interface declaration parsing, catalog concurrency, allocator behavior and final sort ordering are separate contracts; the selection theorem describes exact set membership.

evidence_commands.purpose: source-derived Lean AST certificate, 32,768 complete graph-builder executions and eight negative controls
